places.name: Kingston Market Place
places.description: A historic market place, home to the ancient Coronation Stone of Anglo-Saxon kings.

history.summary: KT2 lies within Kingston upon Thames. A Royal Borough and historic market town where several Anglo-Saxon kings were crowned; the Coronation Stone used in these ceremonies is displayed near the Guildhall.
